name: AIFileAttachment
description: AIFileAttachment is a compact atom for representing an already-selected file inside an AI input surface (ai-dialog, AI Command Center composer, AI Side Drawer composer, AI prompt input). It shows file name, file type, file-type icon, upload/loading state, processing state, unsupported/error state, and a remove control so the user can clear the attachment before sending the prompt. The atom does NOT own the file picker, drag-and-drop, upload API, max-file rules, or submit behavior — the parent composer owns those. File-type icons resolve in priority order: Guild/Guild icon first (when one exists in AIIcon's registry), then Lucide React fallback, then a generic file icon. Status drives visible text + color tone: progress (AI brand surface), warning (Guild orange), error (semantic error). Border-radius is 0 across all states per the DS atom flat-corner rule.
intent: Selected-file chip for AI composers — name, type, status, remove. Does NOT own the picker, upload API, or validation.

authority.note: Imported from godesign27/agentic-ui-design-system (branch cursor/import-ai-components-6d77). Runtime TSX lives under src/components/ai/. Existing top-level shadcn ports remain authoritative for the governed AI kit.

props.name: fileName
props.hint: REQUIRED. Visible name (include extension where possible). Surfaces as title + aria-label when truncated.

props.name: fileType
props.hint: Explicit type label (e.g. "DOCX"). Wins over extension inference.

props.name: fileCategory
props.hint: Explicit category override. Inferred from fileType/extension when omitted.

props.name: fileSize
props.hint: Pre-formatted size string. Atom does not format byte values.

props.name: status
props.hint: default · uploading · processing · unsupported · error · disabled · removing · fileTooLarge · permissionRestricted · virusScanPending · virusScanFailed.

props.name: progress
props.hint: Renders a thin progress bar when status is uploading / processing / virus-scan-pending.

props.name: errorMessage
props.hint: Overrides the default status text when status="error".

props.name: helperText
props.hint: Optional helper line under status (e.g. supported formats in unsupported state).

props.name: disabledReason
props.hint: Surfaces as the remove-button title attribute when status="disabled".

props.name: showFileSize
props.hint: Defaults to true when fileSize is provided.

props.name: onRemove
props.hint: Click handler for the remove control. Button only renders when provided.

props.name: onRetry
props.hint: Click handler for Retry. Button only renders when status="error".
